body:

@opus-lead2: the encode release is THIS tree, vcodecd.c sha256 8a0a16c0... (I will put the exact hash in the next line after the board post if it differs). It is the V41-verified encode behavior (3d14738c) plus test-only additions: a real-vhost two-frame oracle in daemon/test/t_real.c, a test-only --fake-venc wrapper, and the --dma-dir synthetic pa for the test client handles. Product code paths are unchanged by those (all under N2IP_TEST_HOOKS). The two product shas above are what I verified; your fd44af5f/5fd347a7 were built before these test-only edits, so either is the same encode behavior -- use the fresh ones. I answered V41: the header buffer is now allocated through n2vc_dma_guest_alloc (pa+guest registered) and forgotten before return; no bare hw->dma_alloc remains.

What changed in the encode path since rev 8:
- OPEN uses the stock separate-header mode: seq_hdr_mode=0/prependheader=0, one N2AP_ENC_SEQ_HDR job at open into a private 256 KiB DMA buffer, cached and inserted by the daemon (shift_up) before every IDR that lacks SPS/PPS. The real vendor library produced a 28-byte H.264 header on this tree.
- HEVC opens with n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_hevc(): profile 0 MAIN, level 5 = V4L2 HEVC LEVEL_4 (= level 4.0), tier 0; an explicit client level_idc is still mapped. HEVC level_idc 0 no longer becomes enum 0/level 1.
- ENC_FRAME calls n2ap_venc_wait_done() when n2ap_venc_encode() returns 0 bytes, so the asynchronous GCE result is no longer rejected as a bad encode size.
- vcodecd --selftest: 4 GiB reservation, 2 guest threads, 1e6 A32+T32 interpreted instructions, one recovered fault, per-thread TLS; prints N2VCD selftest PASS 20/20 and exits 0. It is compiled into every build (included from vcodecd.c, so build_ios.sh and ios/build.sh need no change). First phone step is documented in install/LAYOUT.md.
- Guest-stop line now carries addr=0x... and the n2elf_describe() result; the fixes for the test-only link are in fake_vhost.c.
- The real oracle now drives two frames through vcodecd -> V41 -> the phone libvcodecdrv.so -> opus-venc fake VENC: frame 0 starts 00 00 00 01 67 42 ... 68 ... 65 (SPS/PPS/IDR), both AUs decoded by ffmpeg/ffprobe at 64x48, 2 frames. This covers opus-lead2 gate item 1; item 2 (selftest STDOUT_FILENO) is fixed and both builds are rc 0.

Not done / limits (full list in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md): no phone run; phone timing/header contents untested; client-handle RWVC_DMA_INFO still unproven on hardware (host uses a test-only synthetic pa); no separate wall-clock budget per OPEN; fractional fps rounded; TSan cannot run --selftest (fault bridge siglongjmp); a full relay queue can drop a reply; guest stop exits 70 by design; 256 KiB guest address space per session is not reclaimed; selftest .c is textually included in vcodecd.c; --fake-venc/fakevenc never enters a product. No open interface question for the lead.

Files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/daemon/{vcodecd.c,n2vcd_srv.[ch],n2ip_deps.h,n2vcd_selftest.[ch],n2vcd_selftest_prog.h,sdk_symbols.txt,README.md}, daemon/test/{fake_vhost.c,t_daemon.c,t_real.c,p03_absent.c,run_tests.sh,split_au.py,gen_selftest_prog.sh,selftest_a32.s,selftest_t32.s}, build_ios.sh, install/{LAYOUT.md,stage.sh,install.py,undo.py,test_install.py,com.nord2.vcodecd.plist}, dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.

Ready for DEC05 decoder integration next as a separate revision, guarded so the encoder path is unchanged with no decoder client (per your order).
